businessHoursDesc: The hours Jawab24 replies automatically — these are not your business hours

businessHours.info: This schedule controls JAWAB24, not your shop. Inside these hours Jawab24 replies automatically: Smart Replies on messages and comments, and Post Reply. Outside them all of it stops — private messages get your away message, while comments and Post Reply get no reply at all. Your shop's real opening hours belong in each page's Business Info, and Jawab24 quotes them from there when customers ask.
businessHours.timezoneSearch: Search for a city or country…
businessHours.timezoneInfo: Your reply schedule — and the working hours Jawab24 quotes to customers — are read in this timezone, not your device's clock. If it is wrong, times silently shift: a 09:00–18:00 schedule set in the wrong zone can start and end an hour early. Set it to where your business actually operates.
businessHours.timezoneEcho: Read in {timezone} time — change it under General at the top of this page.

handoffPause.title: Pause Auto-Reply When I Reply Manually
handoffPause.desc: Pauses auto-reply while you handle the conversation yourself.
handoffPause.info: After you reply manually to a customer, Jawab24 stops sending auto-replies on that conversation for the duration below — so the customer doesn't get two replies for the same message.
handoffPause.warning: Prevents sending double replies to the same customer
handoffPause.why: Why? Prevents sending double replies to the same customer.

replyDelay.title: Reply Delay
replyDelay.desc: A short pause before each reply makes it feel more human
replyDelay.tip: We recommend 2-5 seconds for the most natural feel
replyDelay.example: The actual wait varies slightly each time so it feels natural
replyDelay.formula: Replies never come sooner than the time you set — they arrive a little later, and the timing shifts each time so it feels natural

greetingMessage.desc: Sent when a customer messages you for the first time
greetingMessage.enabledLabel: Send a greeting on first contact
greetingMessage.enabledDescription: When off, the AI handles the first message directly

awayMessage.title: Away Message
awayMessage.desc: Sent for private messages only, once per customer per 24 hours
awayMessage.info: Sent only when a customer sends a PRIVATE MESSAGE while Jawab24's replies are paused — either outside the schedule above, or when Smart Replies for messages are switched off. It is sent at most once per customer every 24 hours, so a long conversation never gets it repeatedly. Comments and Post Reply receive no reply at all while paused — the away message is for private messages only.

limitFallbackMessage.title: Backup Reply at Monthly Limit
limitFallbackMessage.desc: Sent to customers when your monthly Smart Reply limit is reached.
limitFallbackMessage.toggleLabel: Send a reply when the monthly limit is reached
limitFallbackMessage.helperOff: Off — no reply is sent at the limit. Comments and DMs are flagged in your inbox for manual handling.
